title: A Bird Flew 7,500 Miles Without Landing Once

scenes.text: A bird flew 7,500 miles without landing once.
It's a bar-tailed godwit, and it left Alaska headed for New Zealand.
Eleven days, nonstop, over open Pacific water. Scientists think it likely never even slept.
Before the trip, its body nearly doubled in size, about half of it fat, while its stomach and liver shrank to save weight.
The trip ended in a bay near Auckland.
Seven thousand five hundred miles, and it never touched down.

description:
A tagged godwit flew from Alaska to New Zealand in 11 days with no stops.
It flew about 7,500 miles and reached speeds of 55 miles an hour.
Before leaving, it nearly doubled its body size and shrank organs it would not need.
Could you go 11 days without stopping?
first_comment: Would you rather fly 11 days nonstop or swim across the Pacific?
